authority_precedence.statement: User authorization to review and, if accepted, implement this bounded SRCR self-repair.
Current canonical SRCR source; unchanged from spec's source revision for profile paths.
Advisory current-practice evidence; cannot widen scope.

authorized_requirements.statement: For material BOUNDED/DEEP research paths, freeze a compact pre-research leading-solution baseline before external research/challenger evidence is consumed.
Extend the existing SRCR contract/schema with baseline_solution_snapshot, baseline_digest, discovery_deltas and incremental_value_outcome without creating a second reasoning authority.
Add deterministic baseline/delta coherence and independent semantic materiality judgment; producer cannot self-award MATERIAL_UPLIFT and honest NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT remains valid.
Add blind anti-gaming holdouts for real uplift, no uplift, novelty theater, hidden risk and context-cost behavior.

constraints.statement: Do not introduce a mandatory novelty/WOW score or force novelty when no material uplift exists.
Do not create a second discovery agent, runtime, judge authority, or parallel reasoning engine; reuse the existing SRCR producer/challenger and independent semantic boundary.
Historical V0.2 outputs remain readable and LIGHTWEIGHT cases are not overconstrained by incremental-value machinery.
Keep incremental-value transport compact/JIT with soft limit 1200 and hard limit 2400 estimated tokens; never hydrate unrelated governance context.
Incremental-value materiality is decided at the independent semantic quality boundary, not by the producer.
Implementation must remain a bounded profile-pack change with reversible schema/producer/judge enforcement and preserved historical artifacts.

forbidden_changes.statement: Do not add a producer-authored WOW/novelty score as a quality authority.
Do not add a separate discovery producer/agent by default.
Do not require MATERIAL_UPLIFT for every deep case; NO_MATERIAL_UPLIFT must remain a valid evidence-backed outcome.
Do not allow producer-authored MATERIAL_UPLIFT to directly produce quality acceptance.
This self-repair spec review does not authorize unrelated runtime implementation changes, production activation, or profile promotion.

packet_purpose: Independent semantic review of exact SRCR self-repair spec for incremental-value proof before implementation.

related_context_refs.statement: A transversal profile runtime source refresh capability already exists and is separate from this profile-pack repair.
The prior runtime refresh canary is superseded by this new profile-source repair and should not be treated as final behavioral proof for the new revision.
